meta.description: Arail component manifest. Single source of truth for all installable components, versions, update strategies, and known breaking changes. Readable by humans, the CLI, and AI agents.

components.name: arail
components.description: The lab itself — portal, router, agents, PKB, wiki, scheduler
components.check_cmd: git fetch origin main 2>/dev/null; LOCAL=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null); REMOTE=$(git rev-parse origin/main 2>/dev/null); if [ "$LOCAL" != "$REMOTE" ] && [ -n "$REMOTE" ]; then AHEAD=$(git rev-list HEAD..origin/main --count 2>/dev/null); echo "${AHEAD:-?} commits behind origin/main"; fi

components.name: python-deps
components.description: Core Python dependencies from pyproject.toml (FastAPI, MLX, etc.)
components.check_cmd: .venv/bin/python3 -c "import subprocess,json;r=subprocess.run(['.venv/bin/pip','list','--outdated','--format=json'],capture_output=True,text=True);d=json.loads(r.stdout) if r.stdout.strip() else [];names=[p['name'] for p in d[:5]];rest=len(d)-5;s=', '.join(names)+(' +'+str(rest)+' more' if rest>0 else '');print(f'{len(d)} outdated: {s}') if d else None"

breaking_changes.note: FastAPI v1 removes deprecated Starlette re-exports; portal templates may need path updates

components.name: ttyd
components.description: Browser terminal — powers /terminal in the portal

components.name: ollama
components.description: Local LLM server — OpenAI-compatible API for Open Notebook and agent-browser

components.name: agent-browser
components.description: Web research agent — browser automation for the Knowledge tab
components.check_cmd: npm outdated -g agent-browser --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);ab=d.get('agent-browser',{});print(ab.get('latest','')) if ab.get('latest') and ab.get('latest')!=ab.get('current') else None"

components.name: open-notebook
components.description: Self-hosted NotebookLM alternative — research curation surface
components.version_cmd: docker images lfnovo/open_notebook --format '{{.Tag}}  (built {{.CreatedAt}})' 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo 'not pulled'

breaking_changes.note: Open Notebook v2 changes the database schema and migrates from Streamlit to Next.js. See the release notes for migration steps.

components.name: marimo
components.version_cmd: docker images python --format '{{.Tag}}' 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo 'not pulled'

components.name: jupyterlab
components.description: Notebook environment — powers /notebook in the portal
components.check_cmd: .venv/bin/pip list --outdated --format=json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; [print(p['name'],p['version'],'→',p['latest_version']) for p in json.load(sys.stdin) if p['name']=='jupyterlab']"
